task.title: URLs redirected to anchors error
task.body:
https://mozilla.sentry.io/issues/7610217217/

- The input path was `/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Reserved_words`
- This attempted to load `/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Reserved_words/index.json`
- But ended up redirected to https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Lexical_grammar#Keywords/index.json instead

This seemed to happen because the redirect was to a section rather than a full URL, so fixing it in dex would end up losing some context here which we should surface to the LLM.
